messages:
Ana Rivera: Quick sync — CloudArc joint webinar is greenlit for May 28. We're doing a split NA/APAC run to hit both prime windows. Need to confirm speaker rotation, demo handoff points, and swag last-mile.

Michael Chen: Thanks Ana. Confirmed on our side. Who's owning the speaker schedule grid?

Ana Rivera: @Samir you said you'd volunteer to map speaker slots? Can you do a draft by EOD tomorrow? We'll do NA 10:00 PT -> APAC 09:00 SGT (staggered, not simultaneous).

Samir Patel: Yep I can. I'll make a grid with timezone offsets and handoff flags. Quick Q: do we want the same demo twice or a condensed APAC-only version?

Jen Lopez: I'd prefer condensed for APAC — local demo lead (CloudArc APAC) can take final 15m. Saves prep.

Michael Chen: Condensed works. Also we should have a pre-recorded fallback demo in case live remote presenter lags. @Oli can you own a 6min pre-record?

Oli Park: I can do the pre-record. Will record on Monday. Format: 1080p, 16:9, <6 min, 30s intro slide w/ logos. Anything else?

Ana Rivera: Perfect. Add one slide noting model/version and region used (e.g., redwood-v1, quantized-small, hosted-eu). Helps reproducibility.

Samir Patel: Draft grid done: https://tiny.redwood/speaker-grid (private) — includes handoff markers at 5m/2m/0m for each demo.

Charlotte (logistics): Swag update: courier quote received — 2 boxes to SFO press hold, 1 box to SG partner office. ETA windows: SFO 5/24 09:00-17:00, SG 5/25 10:00-18:00. Customs docs need HS codes and invoice amount.

Ana Rivera: Assigning customs & labels to @Charlotte. Please add SKU list. We'll ship sticker packs + 1 demo kit each (USB drive + quickstart card).

Charlotte (logistics): On it. SKU list: RDW-SK-001 (stickers), RDW-KIT-002 (demo kit). Declared value per demo kit: $12.50. I'll attach commercial invoice PDF to the drive.

Michael Chen: For the demo kit USB content: include a README, pre-recorded video, and a small local model checkpoint? Is it okay to include model checkpoint?

Jen Lopez: Avoid including checkpoints due to license & size. Instead include a short CLI script that fetches the test artifact from our secure bucket during demo. Add fallback: local canned responses file.

Samir Patel: For the live handoff, we need a short script snippet to switch to the hosted endpoint. Suggest this snippet in the runbook:

```
# switch to hosted for live handoff
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=REDACTED
python demo_client.py --endpoint https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate --model redwood-v1
```

Charlotte (logistics): Courier contact: AtlasExpress — ref #AX-5492. I'll update with tracking once label created. Recommend we finalize receiver names for SG office to avoid returns.

Ana Rivera: Receiver for SG: "CloudArc APAC — Events" (attn: Mei Ling). For SFO: "Redwood Events — Receiving" (attn: Warehouse Ops).

Marcos (events-bot): Reminder: add webinar to calendar with PT/SG duplicates, enable closed captions, and set registration form.

Jen Lopez: I'll own registration form. Can we add an optional checkbox for receiving swag and a shipping address field? Data retention question — sales ok with collecting addresses?

Michael Chen: Sales is fine as long as we limit to shipping and opt-in, and sync to SF only for those who consent. I'll loop in compliance if needed.

Ana Rivera: Timeline checkpoint: speaker slides due 5/15, pre-record due 5/20, swag items ready for pickup 5/22, shipouts 5/23-5/24. Please flag blockers before end of week.

Oli Park: Pre-record slot booked Mon 5/13 10:00 PT. Will send recording link to this thread.

Samir Patel: Noted. Also putting a 2-person rehearsal schedule: full run-through 5/24 11:00 PT / 5/25 08:00 SGT. Need volunteers for on-call infra during live.

Michael Chen: I'll be on-call for infra during NA window. @Jen can you cover APAC handoff?

Jen Lopez: Yep I can cover APAC. Need a short runbook for rollback to canned video + contact list.

Samir Patel: Draft rollback block for runbook:
1) Mute live stream
2) Play pre-recorded fallback (Oli)
3) Notify attendees via chat + update event banner
4) Postmortem post-event

Charlotte (logistics): Quick note on labeling — use big bold label: "WEBINAR: CLOUDARC + REDWOOD — DO NOT OPEN UNTIL 5/25" on APAC box to avoid early customs clearance mishaps.

Ana Rivera: Love that. Final asks: Samir finalize grid, Oli record fallback, Jen owns reg + APAC ops, Charlotte finalize courier + invoices, Michael infra on-call. I'll do speaker comms and partner runbook. Thanks team — let's reconvene Thursday for a final go/no-go. :raised_hands:
